run_test_interpolation: run the XField interpolation test on a dataset and render output videos to the results directory
render_spiral_path: render a spiral camera path video from the pretrained XField model using the render_spiral flag
render_light_field_row: render a row of the light field using the render_row flag with supersampled columns
render_all_dimensions: render interpolated videos across all light view and time dimension combinations for a 3D XField dataset
precompute_flow_fields: precompute flow fields for all input coordinates using the pretrained Flow model before rendering
